learned_rules.failed_component: Duplicate Detection & Title Lab Optimization Pipeline
learned_rules.root_cause: _check_video_already_published checked the raw subject BEFORE title_lab optimized it, making YouTube query return False and uploading duplicates.
learned_rules.action_plan: Check published status post-optimization, sever legacy video generation from article cron, and query channel upload playlist up to 50 items.
learned_rules.learned_from: Commit eec0973 (Channel duplicate cleanup and legacy loop severing)

learned_rules.failed_component: Legacy MoneyPrinter Pexels Stock Video Generator
learned_rules.root_cause: Article conveyor cron in market_publisher.yml was invoking _generate_and_upload_video_with_healing, producing legacy Pexels stock videos.
learned_rules.action_plan: Enforce strict decoupling: article cron generates only articles, while all video is routed exclusively through 20-runner parallel matrix.

learned_rules.root_cause: An individual matrix runner failed to upload its artifact, leaving aggregate_and_publish with missing segments.
learned_rules.action_plan: Detect missing segment index, synthesize emergency procedural replacement from base frame with FFmpeg pipe, and proceed with concat.

learned_rules.root_cause: Torchaudio default backend failed without soundfile or soxr installed.
learned_rules.action_plan: Install soundfile and soxr via pip, and monkeypatch torchaudio.load and save with soundfile.

learned_rules.root_cause: MoviePy memory leaks and CPU thread lockups during 1080x1920 / 2K video rendering.
learned_rules.action_plan: Bypass MoviePy entirely: stream PIL Image frames directly into FFmpeg stdin via rawvideo pipe with ultrafast preset.

learned_rules.root_cause: Missing essential packages in minimal runner environment.
learned_rules.action_plan: Dynamically pip install missing modules with --no-cache-dir.
learned_rules.auto_executable: pip install --no-cache-dir numpy matplotlib toml openai

learned_rules.root_cause: publish_at variable passed into upload routine before being initialized.
learned_rules.action_plan: Initialize publish_at = None by default before task invocation.

learned_rules.root_cause: Utility modules used in sub-methods without global top-level imports.
learned_rules.action_plan: Dynamically import missing modules into builtins / globals namespace.

learned_rules.signature_pattern: (cannot open resource|dejavusans.*not found|arial.*not found|oserror: cannot open resource)
learned_rules.root_cause: Hardcoded macOS font paths failed on Ubuntu runners.
learned_rules.action_plan: Multi-tier font candidate discovery: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf -> LiberationSans -> ImageFont.load_default().

learned_rules.signature_pattern: (error: failed to push some refs|rejected.*fetch first|non-fast-forward)
learned_rules.root_cause: Autonomous article cron pushed new posts to origin/main while a local or runner process was committing.
learned_rules.action_plan: git stash --include-untracked, git fetch origin main, git rebase -X ours origin/main, git stash pop, retry push up to 3 times with 5s exponential jitter.
learned_rules.auto_executable: git fetch origin main && git rebase -X ours origin/main && git push origin HEAD:main

learned_rules.root_cause: Stale .git/index.lock left behind after runner abort or concurrent git execution.
learned_rules.action_plan: Neutralize lockfile: rm -f .git/index.lock and verify workspace cleanliness.

learned_rules.root_cause: Payload dictionary structure changed without updating Kaggle remote kernel reader.
learned_rules.action_plan: Default segment_index = payload.get('segment_index', 0) and safe access fallback.

learned_rules.signature_pattern: (nameerror: name 'ass_header' is not defined|missing subtitle style header)
learned_rules.root_cause: ASS subtitle formatting header string missing in kernel script.
learned_rules.action_plan: Inject authoritative SSA/ASS v4+ style template with bold yellow stroke text.

learned_rules.root_cause: Masterclass long-format video render exceeded default 1200s (20 min) timeout.
learned_rules.action_plan: Expand KaggleWorker timeout to 2400s (40 min) and split masterclass chapters if necessary.

learned_rules.signature_pattern: (409 conflict|dataset version creation in progress|dataset push failed)
learned_rules.root_cause: Concurrent dataset version pushes triggered HTTP 409 Conflict on Kaggle API.
learned_rules.action_plan: Wait 15s backoff, append random hexadecimal nonce to dataset version metadata, and retry.

learned_rules.root_cause: Transformers > 4.37 and NumPy > 1.26 breaking internal C extensions of Coqui XTTS.
learned_rules.action_plan: Pin exact compatible dependencies: pip install transformers==4.37.2 numpy==1.26.4.

learned_rules.root_cause: Google Cloud OAuth refresh token expired after 7 days (Testing mode) or was revoked.
learned_rules.action_plan: Engage multi-project OAuth pool: hot-swap credentials across Slot 1, Slot 2, SongX Slot 2, or pool JSON, and alert Boss on Telegram.

learned_rules.failed_component: YouTube Data API v3 Quota Ceiling
learned_rules.root_cause: 10,000 units/day quota ceiling reached on primary GCP project.
learned_rules.action_plan: Switch client_id to secondary GCP project from oauth_pool.json. If all projects exhausted, safe-vault video to output/ and schedule release.

learned_rules.signature_pattern: (video already published|duplicate video on channel|playlist items duplicate)
learned_rules.root_cause: Default maxResults=10 only scanned recent uploads; older duplicate titles remained undetected.
learned_rules.action_plan: Expand scan depth to 50-100 playlist items and apply tokenized text similarity score >= 0.85.

learned_rules.root_cause: External edge-tts servers rate-limited or closed WebSocket during batch synthesis.
learned_rules.action_plan: Purge edge-tts dependency: route 100% of speech narration through local offline Christopher voice clone with pitch/formant mastering.

learned_rules.root_cause: Dictionary payload missing 'top_text' key when passed from custom topic generator.
learned_rules.action_plan: Apply safe dictionary access with contextual financial fallback: payload.get('top_text', 'MARKET ALERT').

learned_rules.root_cause: Third-party chart platform blocked headless Chromium or timed out on canvas webgl rendering.

learned_rules.signature_pattern: (name 'Credentials' is not defined|Failed to render/upload CPU Short.*name 'Credentials'|No module named 'faster_whisper')
learned_rules.root_cause: kaggle_worker.py coupled optional faster_whisper import with google.oauth2.credentials.Credentials in a single try-except block, causing Credentials to be undefined on CPU runners and silently failing all companion Shorts uploads.
learned_rules.action_plan: Decouple Google OAuth imports (Credentials, build, MediaFileUpload) into their own standalone try block so YouTube upload functions are always operational regardless of faster-whisper presence.
learned_rules.learned_from: Live incident: Nov 4 Shorts zero-upload failure

learned_rules.root_cause: fetch_today_youtube_uploads counted 'Deleted video' playlist placeholder items as live uploads, masking zero-video state on the channel, while global in-progress run matching blocked overdue slot dispatches.
learned_rules.action_plan: Filter out 'Deleted video' and 'Private video' placeholders from live YouTube audit, and scope active run matching strictly by slot ID and schedule window.

learned_rules.root_cause: Hardcoded choices in argparse (stock_market, crypto, insurance) rejected dynamically discovered valid market verticals (commodities, forex, banking, regulatory).

learned_rules.signature_pattern: (Failed to acquire Kaggle GPU photographic plate|kaggle.*conflict|409.*conflict|kernel.*already running)
learned_rules.root_cause: Multiple GitHub Actions workers pushed metadata to the exact same Kaggle notebook slug simultaneously, causing race conditions and session locks.
learned_rules.action_plan: Implement sequential queueing, exponential backoff, and poll kernel completion before next dispatch.

learned_rules.root_cause: Sub-box mask coordinates computed with anchor=mm while outer rim and extrusion used anchor=mt, causing 3 offset layers.
learned_rules.action_plan: Unify all layers (shadow extrusion, armor rim, face gradient, specular gloss) to a single (cx, line_y) coordinate with anchor=mt.

learned_rules.root_cause: Line spacing was 0.94x (135px) while font height (135px) + extrusion (26px) was 161px, producing negative 26px collision gap.
learned_rules.action_plan: Enforce 1.22x line spacing (175px at 144px font), providing a guaranteed 16px dark separation gap.
